what_happened: A nightly catalog refresh stopped halfway because one vendor entry carried a null price field and the importer had no fallback.
evidence: The planner saw the refresh log end after the fourth vendor package with an unhandled null.
cause: The importer assumed every price was a number.
prevention: Validate numeric fields before the refresh writes any row.
proposal: Leave out vendor entries with missing prices and report each package that was left out at the end of the refresh; the planner reads that report.
general_rule: refresh jobs must validate numeric fields before writing rows
particular_justification: Only the catalog importer writes these rows.
